correctness.rationale: Directly generated all 3^7 point assignments and allowable line choices using Fano difference set (0,1,3); independently constructed the 2106-state recolouring graph, exactly 6804 edges, 126 degree-zero states and the full degree polynomial 126t^4+420t^5+504t^6+588t^8+252t^9+84t^11+6t^14. All-root BFS, one root for each of 1980 mobile states, returned eccentricity 21 for every vertex. Flag bijection derives from sum_i binom(n_i,2)=7 and pair uniqueness; 3-point-colour extension forces the 126 flag states, whereas at most two point colours permit integral heights. The exact monotone height-transform lemma of Cereceda–van den Heuvel–Johnson (2007 preprint Lemma 5) supplies connectedness and the geodesic upper bound; exhaustive BFS supplies sharp metric independent of that lemma.
